name: Blade trap
description: A machete bolted to a small engine's shaft. A tug on the wire opens the throttle and the blade sweeps everything around it.
notes: Made by the player, so usage is empty. Drawn as a two-stroke engine on a plank with the machete flat on its output hub, reaching out to one side. CHECK VOLUME: the blade sticks out 55 cm past a compact engine, so the bounding box is about seven times the reference volume. Set as a trap; the bear trap's `trap` block in items-tools.libsonnet is the model for its tuning, left to integration.

name: Nailboard
description: Planks with nails driven up through them. Anyone who steps on it takes a nail through the foot.
notes: Made by the player, so usage is empty. Three boards on two battens with a grid of nails. Set as a trap; the bear trap's `trap` block in items-tools.libsonnet is the model for its tuning, left to integration.

name: Booby trap
description: A tape-bound can of explosive with a pull pin on a string. Tug the string and it goes off.
notes: Made by the player, so usage is empty. A taped tin can with a striker nail, pull pin and coiled string. Set as a trap; the bear trap's `trap` block in items-tools.libsonnet is the model for its tuning, left to integration.

name: Bubble wrap
description: A roll of plastic sheet full of air bubbles. Laid on the floor, it pops loudly when stepped on.
notes: Drawn as a roll with its end pulled out to show the bubbles; the reference's 6 g sheet is light, so the roll is kept small. The film is see-through in game; the tiles draw it opaque. CHECK VOLUME: a hollow roll's box is about five times the reference volume. Set as a trap; the bear trap's `trap` block in items-tools.libsonnet is the model for its tuning, left to integration.

name: Caltrops
description: A handful of small iron spikes that always land with one point up. Scatter them to lame whatever walks through.
notes: The whole handful is one item, so the row draws five caltrops and carries the reference's 264 g. Police and military usage reflects tyre-spike and area-denial stocks; drop it if caltrops stay craft-only. Set as a trap; the bear trap's `trap` block in items-tools.libsonnet is the model for its tuning, left to integration.

name: Glass caltrops
description: Lumps of glue bristling with broken glass. Scatter them where something will walk.
notes: Made by the player, so usage is empty. Four lumps of amber glue with glass shards set edge out; the tiles draw the glass opaque. The handful is one item at the reference's 264 g. Set as a trap; the bear trap's `trap` block in items-tools.libsonnet is the model for its tuning, left to integration.

name: Tooth caltrops
description: Lumps of glue set with long pointed teeth. Scatter them where something will walk.
notes: Made by the player from teeth of large creatures, so usage is empty. Four glue lumps bristling with teeth. The handful is one item at the reference's 264 g. Set as a trap; the bear trap's `trap` block in items-tools.libsonnet is the model for its tuning, left to integration.

name: Crossbow trap
description: A loaded crossbow lashed to a board with a cord on its trigger. It shoots once when the wire is pulled, then needs reloading.
notes: Made by the player, so usage is empty. A pistol crossbow lashed to a board, bolt on the rail, trigger cord running to a tripwire coil. CHECK VOLUME: the prod spans 50 cm across a slim stock, so its box is far larger than the reference's 1.75 L. Set as a trap; the bear trap's `trap` block in items-tools.libsonnet is the model for its tuning, left to integration.

name: Land mine
description: A buried mine that springs up and bursts when stepped on. Handle it with care.
notes: A bounding fragmentation mine with a three-prong pressure fuze and a safety pin ring. The reference gives 0.5 L, under the drawn can's volume; the 2.36 kg mass is kept. Set as a trap; the bear trap's `trap` block in items-tools.libsonnet is the model for its tuning, left to integration.

name: Light snare kit
description: A wire noose on a pole, two stakes, a mallet and cord. Catches small game alive.
notes: Laid out flat: an 80 cm snare pole with its noose, two stakes, a mallet and a hank of cord, matching the reference's 800 mm longest side. Hunting usage reflects trapping supplies. CHECK VOLUME: the parts laid out leave empty space in the box. Set as a trap; the bear trap's `trap` block in items-tools.libsonnet is the model for its tuning, left to integration.

name: Shotgun trap
description: Two pipe barrels on a board, each with a sprung striker held back by a pin. A pull on the wire fires one or both.
notes: Made by the player, so usage is empty. Two capped pipes strapped to a board with rubber-band strikers and a pin cord to a tripwire coil. CHECK VOLUME: long and slim, so its box is about four times the reference volume. Set as a trap; the bear trap's `trap` block in items-tools.libsonnet is the model for its tuning, left to integration.

name: Tripwire
description: A hank of thin cord with a screw eye on each end. Strung across a doorway, it trips whoever comes through.
notes: Made by the player, so usage is empty. A cord hank with a brass screw eye tied to each end. Set as a trap; the bear trap's `trap` block in items-tools.libsonnet is the model for its tuning, left to integration.
